Title: Senior Backend Developer
Company: Fintech Solutions
Overview:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join our core platform engineering group.
You will architect and build microservices handling millions of daily transactions.

Requirements:
- At least 4 years of experience in backend development.
- Deep proficiency with Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
- Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and Kubernetes.
- Solid understanding of REST APIs and CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with Kafka or event-driven systems.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
